name: release-v0-3-0-pin-freshness
title: Release v0.3.0, advance every first-party pin, enforce pin freshness, quarantine unreachable v2 code
description: Cut release v0.3.0 and advance every first-party action pin off 8636a3983d18de17c49907a4c48170a61b1bb713 (tag v0.1.0, 2026-07-23), which is currently referenced by all five example router workflows and by config/routed-review-setup-v1.json while main sits 252 commits and one full release ahead. Add a release-freshness assertion to scripts/validate-action-metadata.mjs, which today only requires the descriptor actionReference to be a 40-character SHA and never checks it against the current release. Add a supportedContractMajors array to the setup descriptor per collaboration-review contract item R2, and quarantine the eight v2 modules that are unreachable from the src/index.js entrypoint out of the CI gate surface per item R3.
creator: sdelmas
blockedOn: operator publishing the v0.3.0 release tag
notes: Blocked on the operator publishing the v0.3.0 release tag at 744a9f138bba7c60272c7f9e3f8412e435e11b89. The pin-freshness assertion resolves the latest existing release tag, so it cannot go green against a tag that does not exist. See the dated PARK NOTE in prd.md and Gate 0 in implement.md. Clear this blockedOn once `git rev-list -n1 v0.3.0` resolves.
